customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("getData() called")

	self.clearData()
	self.view.custom.gettingData = True
	self.view.custom.showMessage = True
	
	try:
		shortStop = self.view.custom.options.shortStop
		scheduledOnly = self.view.custom.scheduledOnly
		assetPath = self.view.custom.options.assetPath or ''
		assetGroupIdList = [self.view.custom.options.assetGroupId] if self.view.custom.options.assetGroupId is not None else None
		rangeStart = self.view.custom.options.startDate
		rangeEnd = self.view.custom.options.endDate
		if rangeEnd > system.date.now(): rangeEnd = system.date.now()
		if rangeStart >= rangeEnd: 
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Date range is invalid'})
			self.view.custom.gettingData = False
			return
		if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('oeeEnabled', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath':assetPath})):
			assetList = [{'assetId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath})), 'assetPath': assetPath}]
		else:
			assetList = [{'assetId': asset['assetId'], 'assetPath': asset['assetPath']} for asset in system.kanoa.asset.getOperationalAssets({'assetPath':assetPath + '%', 'oeeEnabled': True, 'enabled':True})]
		self.view.custom.eqList = [asset['assetPath'] for asset in assetList]
		scheduleData, utilizationData, perfData, downtimeData = [None] * 4

		for asset in assetList:
			if self.view.custom.cancelData: break
			assetPath = asset['assetPath']
			assetId = asset['assetId']
			self.view.custom.info = {"text": "Getting schedule for %s"%assetPath, "type": "INFO"}

			assetScheduleData = self.getScheduleData(assetPath, rangeStart, rangeEnd)
			if assetScheduleData.rowCount > 0: scheduleData = assetScheduleData if scheduleData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(scheduleData, assetScheduleData)				
			
			self.view.custom.info = {"text": "Getting utilization information for %s"%assetPath, "type": "INFO"}
			assetUtilizationData = self.getUtilizationData(assetId, rangeStart, rangeEnd, assetScheduleData)
			utilizationData = assetUtilizationData if utilizationData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(utilizationData, assetUtilizationData)
			modeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeId', system.kanoa.asset.getModes({'modeName': 'Production'}))

			if scheduledOnly:
				for row in range(assetScheduleData.rowCount):
					if self.view.custom.cancelData: break
	
					pStart = assetScheduleData.getValueAt(row, 'startDate')
					pEnd = assetScheduleData.getValueAt(row, 'endDate')
					self.view.custom.info = {"text": "Getting downtime information for %s from %s to %s"%(assetPath, pStart, pEnd), "type": "INFO"}
					assetDowntimeData = kanoa.events.getDowntimeDataForReliability(assetId, pStart, pEnd, shortStop)
					downtimeData = assetDowntimeData if downtimeData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(downtimeData, assetDowntimeData)			
					
					assetPerfData = system.kanoa.event.getProductionEventsForReliability(assetId, pStart, pEnd, None)
					perfData = assetPerfData if perfData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(perfData, assetPerfData)	
			else:
				self.view.custom.info = {"text": "Getting downtime information for %s from %s to %s"%(assetPath, rangeStart, rangeEnd), "type": "INFO"}
				assetDowntimeData = system.kanoa.event.getDowntimeDataForReliability(assetId, rangeStart, rangeEnd, shortStop)
				downtimeData = assetDowntimeData if downtimeData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(downtimeData, assetDowntimeData)			
				
				assetPerfData = system.kanoa.event.getProductionEventsForReliability(assetId, rangeStart, rangeEnd, None)
				perfData = assetPerfData if perfData is None else system.dataset.appendDataset(perfData, assetPerfData)	
	
			#Calculating Buckets
			#minor stops as dt events that were < 10 minutes
			#Breakdowns as dt events >= 10mins that required a part
			#Process Failures as dt events >= 10mins that didn't required a part
			#Setups and adjustments as time greater than standard time expected for planned downtime events
			#Speed Loss value should be the minutes of lost production based on running the line at less than the standard rate	
				#i.e. If standard rate is 10 units per minute and we ran at 50% for 1 hour, that means we should have produced 600 units, but only produced 300.
				#If the takt time is 1 unit every 6 seconds, 300 units * 6 seconds = 1800 seconds of speed loss.
			#Quality Loss value should be the minutes of lost production based on the amount of scrap * the takt time						
				#i.e. if the takt time is 1 unit every 6 seconds and we scrapped 100 units, our Quality bucket is 600 seconds				

		self.view.custom.data.downtimeData = downtimeData
		if scheduleData is not None: self.view.custom.data.scheduleData = scheduleData
		self.view.custom.data.utilizationData = utilizationData

		if perfData is not None: self.view.custom.data.perfData = perfData	

		oee, a, p, q = self.calcOEE(perfData)
		self.view.custom.data.oee = {'a':a, 'p':p, 'q':q}	
		self.view.custom.data.dtBucketSummary = self.createBucketSummary(downtimeData, perfData)

		if self.view.custom.cancelData: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Get data request canceled'})
		else:
			import time
			time.sleep(0.5)
			self.view.custom.updateCharts = not self.view.custom.updateCharts
			
		self.view.custom.info = {"text": "", "type": "INFO"}		
		self.view.custom.gettingData = False
		self.view.custom.cancelData = False
		self.view.custom.showMessage = False
	except:
		self.view.custom.gettingData = False
		self.view.custom.info = {"text": "There was an error getting the data", "type": "ERROR"}

	return

				for prod in prodList:
					newRows.append([assetPath, prod, 0.0, 0.0])
	
			for i in range(detailData.rowCount):
				idx = assetList.index(detailData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath')) * len(prodList) + prodList.index(detailData.getValueAt(i, 'itemName'))
				newRows[idx][2] += detailData.getValueAt(i, lossSecsCol) or 0
				newRows[idx][3] += 1	#Count

			bucketDetail = system.dataset.toDataSet(['Equipment_Path', 'Product_Code', 'Duration_Secs', 'Count'], newRows)

		else:
			dtData = self.view.custom.data.downtimeData
			deleteRows = [i for i in range(dtData.rowCount) if dtData.getValueAt(i, 'Bucket') != bucket or dtData.getValueAt(i,'assetPath') not in assetList]
			detailData = system.dataset.deleteRows(dtData, deleteRows)
			
			stateList = list(set([detailData.getValueAt(i, 'stateName') for i in range(detailData.rowCount)]))
			newRows = []
			for assetPath in assetList:
				for state in stateList:
					newRows.append([assetPath, bucket, state, 0.0, 0.0])
	
			for i in range(detailData.rowCount):
				idx = assetList.index(detailData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath')) * len(stateList) + stateList.index(detailData.getValueAt(i, 'stateName'))
				newRows[idx][3] += detailData.getValueAt(i, 'stateDurationSecs')
				newRows[idx][4] += 1	#Count
		
			bucketDetail = system.dataset.toDataSet(['Equipment_Path', 'Bucket', 'State', 'Duration_Secs', 'Count'], newRows)

		deleteRows = [i for i in range(bucketDetail.rowCount) if bucketDetail.getValueAt(i, 'Duration_Secs') == 0]
		self.view.custom.data.dtBucketDetail = system.dataset.deleteRows(bucketDetail, deleteRows)
		self.view.custom.data.dtDetailData = detailData
		self.view.custom.info = {"text": "", "type": "INFO"}
		self.view.custom.showMessage = False
#	except:		
#		self.view.custom.info = {"text": "There was an error getting the detailed data", "type": "ERROR"}
		
	self.view.custom.gettingData = False
	
	return

customMethods.name: getUtilizationData
buildModeData
customMethods.script:
if data is None: return data
	eqList = self.view.custom.eqList		
	modeList = list(set([data.getValueAt(i, 'modeName') for i in range(data.rowCount)]))
	hdr = ['Type', 'eqPath'] + modeList
	
	modeArray = [['ACTUAL',eqList[y]] + [0 for i in range(len(modeList))] for y in range(len(eqList))]
	for row in range(data.rowCount):
		eqPath = data.getValueAt(row, 'assetPath')
		if eqPath not in eqList: continue
		mode = data.getValueAt(row, 'modeName')
		if mode not in modeList: continue
		durationSecs = data.getValueAt(row, 'durationSecs') or 0
		modeArray[eqList.index(eqPath)][modeList.index(mode)+2] += int(durationSecs)
	
	data = system.dataset.toDataSet(hdr, modeArray)
	
	######
	#This next section is just to put the modes in the order of magnitude to show it as a pareto. Sure there is a simpler wa of doing this...
	sumList = [0 for i in range(data.getColumnCount())]
	for row in range(data.rowCount):
		for col in range(2, data.getColumnCount()):
			sumList[col] += data.getValueAt(row, col)
	
	colHeaders = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(data)
	newRows = [[colHeaders[col], sumList[col]] for col in range(2, len(colHeaders))]

	sumData = system.dataset.toDataSet(['mode', 'sum'], newRows)
	sumData = system.dataset.sort(sumData, 'sum', False)
	hdrList = ['Type', 'eqPath'] + [sumData.getValueAt(i, 'mode') for i in range(sumData.rowCount)]	
	data = system.dataset.filterColumns(data, hdrList)
	######
	
	return data

customMethods.name: getScheduleData
customMethods.script:
linePath = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getParentAsset('line', assetPath),0)['assetPath']
	eventData = system.kanoa.schedule.getCalendarEvents({'scheduleType': 'operation', 'startDate': system.date.addDays(rangeStart, -1), 'endDate': rangeEnd, 'assetPath': linePath})

	header = ['name','assetPath','startDate','endDate','modeTypeName','workOrder','productCode','scheduledQty','notes']
	rowDicts = []
	for eventRow in eventData:
		if eventRow.get('modeTypeName') != 'Production': continue
		if eventRow['endDate'] < rangeStart: continue
	
		rowDict = {key: eventRow.get(key) for key in header if key != 'durationSecs'}
	
		if rowDict['startDate'] < rangeStart: rowDict['startDate'] = rangeStart
		if rowDict['endDate'] > rangeEnd: rowDict['endDate'] = rangeEnd
	
		rowDict['durationSecs'] = system.date.secondsBetween(rowDict['startDate'], rowDict['endDate'])
		rowDicts.append(rowDict)
	
	rows = [[rowDict.get(column) for column in header] for rowDict in rowDicts]
	return system.dataset.toDataSet(header, rows)

customMethods.name: createBucketSummary
customMethods.script:
bucketList = ['PLANNED', 'QUALITY_LOSS', 'SPEED_LOSS', 'MINOR_STOP', 'BREAKDOWN', 'PROCESS_FAILURE', 'SETUP']
	newRows = []

	dtAssetList = [dtData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath') for i in range(dtData.rowCount)] if dtData is not None else []
	perfAssetList = [perfData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath') for i in range(perfData.rowCount)] if dtData is not None else []
	assetList = list(set(dtAssetList + perfAssetList))
				
	if dtData is not None: 
		for assetPath in assetList:
			for bucket in bucketList:				
				newRows.append([assetPath, bucket, 0.0, 0.0])

		for i in range(dtData.rowCount):
			idx = assetList.index(dtData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath')) * len(bucketList) + bucketList.index(dtData.getValueAt(i, 'Bucket'))
			newRows[idx][2] += dtData.getValueAt(i, 'stateDurationSecs')
			newRows[idx][3] += 1	#Count

	if perfData is not None:
		sIdx = bucketList.index('SPEED_LOSS')
		qIdx = bucketList.index('QUALITY_LOSS')	
		for i in range(perfData.rowCount):
			idx = assetList.index(perfData.getValueAt(i, 'assetPath')) * len(bucketList)
			speedLossSecs = perfData.getValueAt(i, 'performanceLossSecs')
			qualityLossSecs = perfData.getValueAt(i, 'qualityLossSecs')
			newRows[idx + sIdx][2] += speedLossSecs or 0.0
			if speedLossSecs > 0: newRows[idx + sIdx][3] += 1	
			newRows[idx + qIdx][2] += qualityLossSecs or 0.0
			if qualityLossSecs > 0: newRows[idx + qIdx][3] += 1				

	data = system.dataset.toDataSet(['Equipment_Path', 'Bucket', 'Duration_Secs', 'Count'], newRows)
	
	deleteRows = [i for i in range(data.rowCount) if data.getValueAt(i, 'Duration_Secs') == 0]
	return system.dataset.deleteRows(data, deleteRows)

customMethods.name: calcOEE
customMethods.script:
if perfData is None: return 0, 0, 0, 0
	
	runtimeSecs, downtimeSecs, infeedCount, outfeedCount, wasteCount, targetCount = [0.0] * 6
	data = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(perfData)
	for row in data:	
		runtimeSecs += row['runtimeSecs'] or 0
		downtimeSecs += row['unplannedDowntimeSecs'] or 0
		outfeedCount = row['outfeedCount'] or 0.0
		targetCount += row['targetCount'] or 0.0
		infeedCount += row['infeedCount'] or 0.0
		wasteCount += row['wasteCount'] or 0.0

	a = float(runtimeSecs) / float((runtimeSecs) + float(downtimeSecs)) if runtimeSecs > 0 else 0.0
	p = float(infeedCount)/float(targetCount) 	if targetCount != 0 else 0.0			
	q = float(infeedCount - wasteCount) / float(infeedCount) if infeedCount != 0 else 0.0							
				
	if p > 1: p = 1.0	#Always Cap Performance			
	oee = a*p*q
		
	return oee, a, p, q
